title: Linear equations in Piatetski-Shapiro primes
summary: We establish discorrelation estimates between the Piatetski-Shapiro prime set \[ \mathcal{P}_γ := \{p \text{ is prime and } p = \lfloor n^{1/γ} \rfloor \text{ for some } n \in \mathbb{N}\} \] and arbitrary nilsequences when $γ\in (0,1)$ is sufficiently close to $1$. This extends earlier works which treated linear or polynomial exponential phase functions.
